question: Raja Harishchandra, a movie directed by Dadasaheb Phalke in 1913, is considered as first full length film of ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Raja Harishchandra"** is considered the **first full-length feature film of Indian cinema.**
 
• It was directed by **Dadasaheb Phalke and released in 1913**.
 
• The film was a silent, black-and-white production that told the story of King **Harishchandra from Hindu mythology.**
 
• It marked the beginning of the **Indian film industry and set the stage for the growth and development of Indian cinema **in the years to come.
 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke **is often referred to as the "father of Indian cinema" for his pioneering efforts in filmmaking.
